pricing.title: Start free.
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes the science. Choose how deep you want to go.
pricing.freeDesc: Begin your self-discovery journey. Explore your interests and meet your career archetype.
pricing.reportDesc: Your complete career identity portrait. 86 questions across 5 psychology frameworks, a personalized 5-chapter report, and your full psychological profile.
pricing.journeyDesc: Your report plus an AI coach that reads your assessment context — your values, tensions, and career directions. Ask anything, get answers that fit your responses more closely.
pricing.guaranteeDesc: If the experience does not meet expectations, contact us and we'll help under the applicable policy.
pricing.coachingDesc: for additional AI coaching sessions after your journey.
pricing.inviteDesc: to unlock full access for free.
pricing.socialProofFoundation: Built on O*NET Interest Profiler, IPIP Big Five, Schwartz Values, SJT, and Holland Theory — validated instruments used in career research worldwide.
pricing.faq1q: What do I get with the free plan?
pricing.faq1a: A 38-question Quick Dive that maps your RIASEC interest profile and value orientation, reveals your career archetype, and gives you 3 free AI coaching sessions. No credit card required.
pricing.faq2q: How is this different from MBTI or other personality tests?
pricing.faq2a: Deep Dive uses 5 validated psychology frameworks — not just one. You get a multi-dimensional career identity portrait based on your interests, personality, values, cognitive style, and situational judgment. It's closer to what a career psychologist would use than a 10-minute quiz.
pricing.faq3a: Career anchors, personalized career direction matches (with AI-generated narratives), shadow & career drain analysis, a personal letter synthesizing your results, and a methodology overview. Each direction is analyzed through your unique psychological lens.
pricing.faq4q: Can I upgrade from Report to Full Journey later?
pricing.faq4a: Yes. If you start with the Report plan, you can upgrade to Full Journey anytime by paying the $20 difference.
pricing.faq5a: We offer 30-day satisfaction support. If the report doesn't meet your expectations, contact us and we'll help under the applicable policy.
pricing.faq6a: Absolutely. Your data is never sold or used to train AI models. You can delete everything with one click, anytime. Privacy is a core design principle, not an afterthought.
